value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym for ages 1 to 3 with a parent, 45 min - their site says fall registration opened July 22. Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent & Tot for 18 months to 3y11m, 30 min. I could not get into either page today, so no day or price yet; I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
